annotation_indices.description: Stable annotation indices rendered on this frame.

captioned.description: Whether a caller caption alters this presentation frame.

change_state_ids.description: Semantic states nominally scheduled into a change overlay on this frame.

cursor_mask_state_id.description: Semantic state used when a cursor mask affected this frame.

encoded_pixel_change.description: Whether this frame uses actual adjacent decoded encoded-pixel comparison.

operation.description: `source` for retimed frames or `hold` for generated duplicates.

source_frame.description: Native base source frame used for this output.

transforms.description: Presentation-only transforms applied to this frame.
